name: Default
shortDescription: Headless email client that turns IMAP, SMTP, Gmail API and Microsoft Graph mailboxes into one REST API with webhooks, backed by Redis.

alerts.message: The admin dashboard has no password on first start. Open it right after deploying and click Enable authentication to set one before anyone else reaches it.

EmailEngine is commercial source-available software. Until a 14-day trial is started or a paid license key is registered from the dashboard, all workers except the API stay suspended and no accounts sync.
